Authorized_Specification: Mandatory evaluation against primary reference baselines: M0 Persistence, M0 Historical Mean, and M2 Bayesian Ridge (Unweighted)
Evaluation_Scope: Individual Basins and Domain A Aggregate
Designated_Models_or_Methods: M0_Persistence (Dynamic Benchmark), M0_Historical_Mean (Climatological Benchmark), M2_Bayesian_Ridge (Unweighted Inference Benchmark)
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: M0_Persistence predicts y_{b, t-1}. M0_Historical_Mean predicts expanding historical mean of training partition.

Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Historical mean strictly uses pre-test training records (<= 2015).

Evaluation_Scope: 27 physical basin-year observations (3 basins x 9 years) + 9 Domain A regional diagnostic records = 36 total evaluation rows

Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: Test period strictly quarantined until pre-test pipeline freeze is confirmed.
Permitted_Preprocessing: Exogenous climate features (SMB) and dynamic flux features (Discharge) must adhere strictly to operational availability rules.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: Annual-rate evaluation (N=27 physical) and 9-year cumulative endpoint drift (t=2016 to 2024).
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: 95% prediction interval coverage over N=27 physical points.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: One-way execution: test targets are unsealed only at the final evaluation step.

Protocol_Dimension: Permitted Feature Availability and Lag Rules
Authorized_Specification: Task A2 Retrospective Hindcast Emulation: Strict Lag-1 and Lag-2 features. Zero contemporaneous target or forcing features.
Evaluation_Scope: Feature Matrix X_test(t) for t in 2016–2024
Designated_Models_or_Methods: Target_Lag1 (y_{t-1}), Target_Lag2 (y_{t-2}), SMB_Lag1 (t-1), Discharge_Lag1 (t-1), Net_MB_Lag1 (t-1), Static Descriptors (A_b, H_b, B_b, tau_d), Basin Dummies
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: For year t, features are strictly derived from year <= t-1. Contemporaneous RACMO SMB(t) or Flux(t) is strictly prohibited.
Permitted_Preprocessing: Imputation and scaling parameters frozen from the 1979–2015 training set.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: Feature availability audit manifest verifying zero lag-0 leakage.
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Verify that observation weights use pre-test annual uncertainties.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Verification check halts pipeline if any feature timestamp >= t.

Authorized_Specification: Models trained on full historical training partition (1979–2014, with 2015 embargo preserved to prevent transition leakage)
Evaluation_Scope: Training Set: N = 108 physical basin-years (3 basins x 36 years: 1979–2014). Optional 2015 transition check.
Designated_Models_or_Methods: All models fit on training partition once, then evaluated out-of-sample on test set.
Permitted_Preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted on 1979–2014 training data only; applied to 2016–2024 test features without refitting.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: Training loss vs test error comparison to evaluate generalization gap.
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Bayesian Ridge noise precision lambda fixed from training partition.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Zero iterative updating on test targets; zero test set retraining.

Authorized_Specification: Point prediction accuracy evaluated on physical basin observations (N = 27)
Evaluation_Scope: Physical Basin Observations (Domain A excluded from pooled metrics)
Designated_Models_or_Methods: Pooled across basins and broken down per basin (Hp-I: N=9, I-Ipp: N=9, Ipp-J: N=9)
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: All metrics calculated directly from raw residuals: e_{b,t} = y_hat_{b,t} - y_{b,t}.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: RMSE = sqrt(mean(e^2)), MAE = mean(|e|), Mean Bias = mean(e), R2 = 1 - sum(e^2)/sum((y - y_bar)^2)
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Cluster-robust paired difference testing (preserving 9 annual clusters) vs Historical Mean.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Independent recalculation script verifies all metric formulas.

Authorized_Specification: Audit basin-specific residual trajectories to detect regional regime shifts and post-2015 acceleration
Evaluation_Scope: Basins Hp-I, I-Ipp, and Ipp-J separately (N = 9 years each)
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: Examine whether Basin Ipp-J post-collapse bias persists into 2016–2024; examine whether Palmer Land (Hp-I) acceleration is captured.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: Basin RMSE, MAE, Mean Bias, and trajectory plots.
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Document structural bias due to lack of dynamic ice-shelf state variables.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Post-hoc physical attribution without adjusting model predictions.

Authorized_Specification: Regional Domain A prediction generated strictly by summing the three basin predictions: y_hat_{DomainA, t} == sum_b y_hat_{b,t}
Evaluation_Scope: Domain A Regional Diagnostic (9 test years)
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: Domain A is NEVER trained as an independent basin. Zero independent Domain A models.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: |y_hat_{DomainA, t} - sum_b y_hat_{b,t}| == 0.000000 km3/yr (Machine precision check)
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Domain A prediction interval derived by propagating basin covariance.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Automated assertion check in pipeline halts execution if discrepancy > 1e-9 km3/yr.

Authorized_Specification: Cumulative volume anomaly trajectory evaluated from 2016 to 2024: Delta V(t) = sum_{k=2016}^t y_hat_k
Evaluation_Scope: Domain A and Basin-Level Cumulative Trajectories
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: Cumulative drift evaluated as endpoint error: Drift = Delta V_pred(2024) - Delta V_true(2024).
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: Endpoint Drift (km3), Path Drift (max absolute error along 9-year trajectory), % Mass Loss Captured
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Persistence telescoping identity audited: sum_{t=2016}^{2024} (y_{t-1} - y_t) == y_{2015} - y_{2024}.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Verify that low endpoint drift is not claimed as skilled dynamic modeling when telescoping applies.

Authorized_Specification: Probabilistic evaluation of 95% credible intervals: empirical coverage, sharpness, and CRPS
Evaluation_Scope: Bayesian Ridge and Gaussian Process (N = 27 physical points)
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: Predictive interval evaluated at y_hat +/- 1.96 * sigma_pred.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: Coverage % = count(covered) / N; Sharpness = mean(2 * 1.96 * sigma_pred); CRPS formula for Gaussian distribution.
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Document homoscedastic noise limitation: verify whether interval width is identical across basins despite unequal physical noise.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: Coverage reported per basin to prevent masked cross-basin cancellation.

Authorized_Specification: Strict one-way revelation protocol: all model scripts, feature matrices, and evaluation pipelines must be committed and locked BEFORE test targets are merged
Operational_Constraints_and_Lag_Rules: Zero feedback loop from test metrics back into model selection, architecture, or hyperparameters. Test metrics are recorded once in immutable CSVs.
Quantitative_Metrics_and_Formulas: Audit trail log recording execution timestamp and script hash.
Calibration_and_Uncertainty_Audit: Verify that test results are not used to select the winning model; winner was pre-selected in Phase 4B/4B.1.
Anti_Leakage_and_Sealing_Enforcement: STRICT PROHIBITION: Any modification of models or features after viewing 2016–2024 targets voids test validity.
